tools.name: documenso_list_documents
tools.description: List documents, optionally filtered by status, folder, source template or a text query. Documenso v2: GET /document.

tools.name: documenso_get_document
tools.description: Fetch a single document with its recipients, fields and current status. Documenso v2: GET /document/{documentId}.

tools.name: documenso_get_documents_by_ids
tools.description: Fetch several documents in one call. Read-only despite being a POST — the v2 API is action-shaped. Documenso v2: POST /document/get-many.

tools.name: documenso_get_recipient
tools.description: Fetch a single recipient — their email, role, signing order and whether they have signed. Documenso v2: GET /document/recipient/{recipientId}.

tools.name: documenso_get_field
tools.description: Fetch a single document field — its type, page, position and inserted value. Documenso v2: GET /document/field/{fieldId}.

tools.name: documenso_list_document_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments on one document. Documenso v2: GET /document/attachment.

tools.name: documenso_get_document_download_url
tools.description: Get a download URL for a document's PDF. Returns a link, not the file bytes. Documenso v2: GET /document/{documentId}/download.

tools.name: documenso_list_templates
tools.description: List reusable document templates. Templates are how you create a new document without uploading a PDF. Documenso v2: GET /template.

tools.name: documenso_get_template
tools.description: Fetch a single template with its recipient placeholders and fields — read this before calling documenso_create_document_from_template so you know the recipient ids. Documenso v2: GET /template/{templateId}.

tools.name: documenso_list_folders
tools.description: List folders used to organise documents and templates. Documenso v2: GET /folder.

tools.name: documenso_create_document_from_template
tools.description: Create a new document from an existing template, filling in the real recipients. Set distribute_document to true to send it for signature immediately. Call documenso_get_template first to read the placeholder recipient ids. Documenso v2: POST /template/use.

tools.name: documenso_add_recipient
tools.description: Add a signer, approver, viewer or CC to a draft document. Documenso v2: POST /document/recipient/create.

tools.name: documenso_distribute_document
tools.description: Send a draft document to its recipients for signature. This emails real people. Documenso v2: POST /document/distribute.

tools.name: documenso_redistribute_document
tools.description: Resend the signing invitation to named recipients of an already-sent document. This emails real people. Documenso v2: POST /document/redistribute.

tools.name: documenso_duplicate_document
tools.description: Copy an existing document into a new draft, keeping its fields. Documenso v2: POST /document/duplicate.

tools.name: documenso_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder for organising documents or templates. Documenso v2: POST /folder/create.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "documenso_get_template" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fetch a single template with its recipient placeholders and fields — read this before calling documenso_create_document_from_template so you know the recipient …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_get_document_download_url, documenso_create_document_from_template · Private data: documenso_list_documents, documenso_get_document, documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_get_field, documenso_list_document_attachments, documenso_get_document_download_url, documenso_list_templates, documenso_list_folders, documenso_create_document_from_template, documenso_add_recipient, documenso_distribute_document, documenso_redistribute_document, documenso_duplicate_document, documenso_create_folder · Public sink: documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_create_document_from_template, documenso_add_recipient, documenso_distribute_document, documenso_redistribute_document, documenso_duplicate_document, documenso_create_folder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_get_document_download_url, documenso_create_document_from_template · Private data: documenso_list_documents, documenso_get_document, documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_get_field, documenso_list_document_attachments, documenso_get_document_download_url, documenso_list_templates, documenso_list_folders, documenso_create_document_from_template, documenso_add_recipient, documenso_distribute_document, documenso_redistribute_document, documenso_duplicate_document, documenso_create_folder · Public sink: documenso_get_documents_by_ids, documenso_get_recipient, documenso_create_document_from_template, documenso_add_recipient, documenso_distribute_document, documenso_redistribute_document, documenso_duplicate_document, documenso_create_folder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
